items.name: Agoura Hills Fall 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AgouraHillsFall2026#80911-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE0Mjc2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb6c9f3a1a6d35945221e7d6f44f5de82b9113a6/SCG_logo_white_bg-removebg-preview.png)

1. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AhmedabadWinterOpen2026#80577-new-competitor-information) tab before registering.

2. All competitors should be familiar with the information in all the tabs. Check out all the Tabs for more detailed information.

3. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.

4. Make sure you are available at the venue at least 20 minutes prior to your respective event's start time. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late.

5. No exceptions will be made unless discussed with the WCA Delegates in advance (contact us via the "Contact" section on the main page)

6. The final decision and rights to accept/deny the exeception request remains with the WCA Delegates.

7. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification.

items.name: GA Cubers Park Be Quiet 2026
items.information:
This competition has **only** Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events and is not suitable for most first-time competitors. If you are interested in competing in regular speedsolving events, you may want to look into [Clocking in Cobb 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockinginCobb2026) two weeks before or one of the Atlanta-area weeknight competitions taking place throughout the fall.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

items.name: Square-1 & Sides in Surrey 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)

### *IMPORTANT: Please note that this is a side events competition, meaning that 3x3x3 speedsolving will not be held at this competition. First-time competitors are still very welcome to participate! However, please check the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Square1SidesinSurrey2026#competition-events) to see which events will be offered at this competition before registering.*

If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held at this one, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA).

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition.

**Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
